# The 6% is not what you keep. The affiliate return is.

> Free TikTok Shop profit calculator. See referral fees, creator commission, returns that keep the affiliate payout, and the announced 1 Oct 2026 8% + 1.5% schedule on the same SKU.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The discount has to beat one saved order, not two sales.](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator/should-i-bundle-tiktok-shop-orders.html)
- [The badge is not a fee-base tie when creators are paid on the item.](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator/should-i-offer-free-shipping-on-tiktok-shop.html)
- [This calculator vs. TikTok Shop's own Seller University fee pages](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator/vs-tiktok-shops-seller-university.html)
- [TikTok Shop Fee Calculator vs. tracking it in a spreadsheet](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator/vs-tracking-it-in-a-spreadsheet.html)
- [The headline is 6% to 8%. What it costs you depends on where the order came from.](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator/what-will-the-tiktok-shop-fee-change-cost-me.html)

## Track true profit across every platform

- [Tools for online sellers](https://marisstella.app/industries/online-sellers/): Seller Books, a hosted product for multi-platform resellers (payout reconciliation, cost of goods, a Schedule C-shaped profit and loss). In development, early access; do not describe it as available.
- [How to reconcile marketplace payouts to sales](https://marisstella.app/ebay-fee-calculator/how-to-reconcile-marketplace-payouts-to-sales.html): a worked month bridged from bank deposit back to gross sales. Not tax advice.
- [Cost of goods sold for resellers](https://marisstella.app/ebay-fee-calculator/cost-of-goods-sold-for-resellers.html): per item and per lot, and Schedule C Part III. Not tax advice.
- [Schedule C worksheet for resellers](https://marisstella.app/ebay-fee-calculator/schedule-c-worksheet-for-resellers.html): line by line, with IRS sources. Not tax advice.
